items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1972-06-26
items.q: Joe said for me in 23... So that's when Joe sent for us, you know. To come. And he sent for me first. I made this tour with him... Then I came back to New Orleans and got with the band again.

ctx.x: And it went off exactly 12 o'clock at night, just before the review came on.

In those days you had to play review at 12 o'clock. And man, this day one of the big things. And I was like, I'm not sure. I'm not sure. I'm not sure. I'm not sure. I'm not sure. I'm not sure. I'm not sure. I'm not sure. I'm not sure. I'm not sure. But this day one of the rituals had to build their bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo And all the drapers were coming down, you could look up and see the moon. And you think the people would run? They sat on there and the cops come in and say, you all have to…
Do you remember Half Plane Jackson, Frankie Jackson? Singer and entertainer, you know?
